facts.text: Starting in fall 2025, Pell-eligible Massachusetts residents can attend Worcester State with zero dollars in tuition and fees under the ValuePlus program.

sources.title: Know Early. No Brainer. | Be a Lancer - Worcester State University
sources.quote: Starting in the fall of 2025, qualifying students will be able to attend Worcester State with $0 tuition and fees. To qualify, students must be Massachusetts residents and Pell-eligible.
